_doc: Thiên Xu Tông cast, batch 3: the last tier B and tier C (inner and outer disciples, stewards, the outer gate).

people.role: Công Tôn Duẫn's disciple and Doãn Hi Hòa's open rival
people.appearance: Square-jawed and restless, always half a step ahead of his master in a corridor.
people.backstory: Born at Thiên Ngoại Khoáng, where Thối Tinh Môn digs the iron it says fell with the stars (A222), Nhiễm Thừa Nghiệp is Công Tôn Duẫn's (cong_ton_duan) disciple and believes his master has been robbed of the Seal by a girl from the head's own family. He has fought Doãn Hi Hòa (doan_hi_hoa) on the training floor eleven times and lost seven. He also lost the inner-gate trial to Cừu Bất Ngữ, who cannot speak, and he is still angry about that. He has twice broken a junior's wrist on the floor for laughing at his master's name.
people.wants: The Seal for his master, and Doãn Hi Hòa laid flat in front of the whole floor.
people.secret: He has greased the third rung of the heir's practice ladder to drop her in the next trial, and Cừu Bất Ngữ saw him do it and, being mute, cannot say.

ties.note: would put him on the Seal tomorrow
seven losses in eleven
beat him at the trial without a word
the boy from his mine

tree.intent: The Metal land toward crit chance and speed.
tree.targets_note: Pivot route, then Myriad Cuts and Autumn Wind for crit chance and speed: the rushed handle.

build.note: Rushes the handle and loses the count.

people.role: Guest armourer of the seat, son of Thối Tinh Môn's head
people.exception: khách khanh (R2): a smith lent by the vassal Thối Tinh Môn as the seat's armourer; runs his father's forge method, not the lineage
people.appearance: Burn-flecked forearms, a leather apron over guest's blue, and a laugh that carries from the forge to the gate.
people.backstory: The second son of Cát Lưu Quang (cat_luu_quang), head of the vassal smiths of Thối Tinh Môn (A231), Cát Thối Phong has kept the seat's forge since 1170 as a guest of the Pivot. He reforges the guard's blades, sharpens the hawk's spear and drinks with the vein guard. Slowly and without permission, he is working on drawings of the halberd Trầm Sa Kích that his sect forged for Quý Trường Kích in 600 (C124), which lies under the barrow.
people.wants: To reforge Trầm Sa Kích in his own name, and to be a head's son who is also a master.
people.secret: He sells the guard's worn blade-steel back to the smelters at the seat's price and draws the credit twice; his father Cát Lưu Quang's accounts show the ingots both ways.

ties.note: his father, who lent him to the Pivot
wants the halberd remade; so does the smith
will not let him near the barrow
his niece at Thôi Tinh
his elder brother at Thôi Tinh, who has no Fire and stayed with their father
his son; inner disciple of the anvil hall, Cát Thối Phong's son, raised by his uncle

tree.intent: The Metal land toward crit damage; a smith tests his own blades.
tree.targets_note: Thối Tinh smiths' route (his father's lineage, not the Pivot's), then Jade Carving and Moon Blade for crit damage: a smith testing his own blades.

build.note: Outside the lineage: a Thối Tinh smith's method and a forge-scarred hide.

people.gloss: Thường Hi, mother of the moons, sister to the sun's charioteer
people.role: Outer disciple; Doãn Hi Hòa's niece and the head's kin
people.appearance: Round-faced and cheerful, in a borrowed yak-wool coat, with the Doãn ledger-keeper's ink stain already on her finger.
people.backstory: Doãn Thường Hi is Doãn Hi Hòa's (doan_hi_hoa) brother's daughter, the second of the bridge-ledger house to come up the mountain in a generation. She has an Earth root and a Metal root of forty, five short of the inner gate. She sits in the outer gate on Thạch Quyền Phong with the herders' children and lets no one call her by her surname, because Chử Bình Quân (chu_binh_quan) has made it plain that the beam will not tip for family.
people.wants: To pass the Level Beam on her own weight, under her own name.
people.secret: She has filed a pebble to the weight of a Metal forty and means to ask Uất Trì Thu to swap it in at the solstice, and has not understood what it would do to Chử Bình Quân.

ties.note: the outer gate's master
her aunt, named heir in 1190
the barley girl beside her on the beam

tree.intent: The Earth land toward guard; her Metal has to grow first.
tree.targets_note: Luyện Khí: only Mountain Hollow of the Pivot route fits her points, then Earth Root's block and Unwavering Faith near the start; the Metal end waits on her Metal.

build.note: Earth carries her; the beam waits on her Metal.

people.gloss: Kinh Trập, the solar term when thunder wakes the insects
people.role: Inner disciple with a Thunder root from Cùng Mục Phong, whom Thính Vũ has tried to buy
people.appearance: Small and sharp, hair standing up in dry weather, a burn on one palm from a stone she picked up as a child, and her left foot never still.
people.backstory: A herder's girl from the slopes of Cùng Mục Phong, the thunder peak where Tư Không Hạc Niên and Thang Vô Tạ fought for three days (C186), Mặc Kinh Trập has Thunder in her root from the land. In 1198 the Tower's vault master Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon), who heads its Thunder Hall, offered the Pivot's envoy a thunder-stone forge in exchange for her. The envoy said no without asking her. Đái Hổ Thần (dai_ho_than) told her, to see her face, and she wants to know what Lệ would teach.
people.wants: To learn what Lệ Tiêu Hồn would teach, and then to say no to his face.
people.secret: She writes to Lệ Tiêu Hồn through a herder boy of Cùng Mục Phong under a false name, asking only about thunder-stone, and Đái Hổ Thần reads the replies first.

ties.note: her drillmaster
the only other Thunder at the seat; he watches her
offered a forge for her in 1198; she has heard about it and wants to know what he would teach

tree.intent: The Metal land first, as the hall requires; she looks at the Thunder land and is told not to.
tree.targets_note: Luyện Khí: Metal Marrow, the first piece of the Pivot route, then Metal Root and Fine Steel for Metal crit; the rest of the route, and the Thunder land, wait.

build.note: A lineage disciple with a root the lineage does not use.

people.gloss: Plans for the south, like Trang Tử's roc
people.role: Keeper of the boundary rolls and the Compact's great map
people.appearance: Map-roller callus on one shoulder; his eyes flick to the door before he answers anything.
people.backstory: Keeps the Compact's great map in Tàng Ước Các; he has noticed the stele below Thủ Bi Trại sits forty paces off its line (V129), and he guesses what Thích Minh Thư (thich_minh_thu) found. He keeps two copies of the great map and shows every visitor the older, Thích Minh Thư (thich_minh_thu) among them, who has twice measured a border from the wrong lines.

ties.note: the keeper
guesses her secret
they share a room and little else

people.gloss: Iron face: a judge's man who cannot be moved
people.role: Bailiff of the Bridge Court
people.appearance: Coughs like a mine-shaft; the club hangs from his belt on a loop worn shiny.
people.backstory: A sulphur-miner's son from Lưu Hoàng who still smells faintly of eggs (A209); he serves the Bridge Court's summonses and has carried Phương Trực Ngôn's (phuong_truc_ngon) verdicts to the gates of four great sects. He serves summonses with the club, and once beat the runner Trì Truyền Thanh (tri_truyen_thanh) with it for a late summons, so that the boy carried the next one with a bound hand.

ties.note: the Chief Judge
the clerk who almost tells him things
porter on the Thạch Kiều road, who carries the Bridge Court's case boxes

people.role: Keeper of the seven witness-houses of the Compact at Thạch Kiều
people.appearance: Rings on all ten fingers; his smile reaches the table a moment before the guest's purse does.
people.backstory: Keeps the seven guest-houses where the great sects' Compact witnesses lodge at Thạch Kiều (N-thien_xu-03), dices with the junior judge Trọng Khắc Kỷ (trong_khac_ky), keeps the ledgers Thích Minh Thư asked about. He rents spare beds to merchants; last Compact day the Lạc Hà witness slept on Bùi Kiến Chứng's (bui_kien_chung) floor. His brother, who keeps a guest-house on the road, has not walked since Đồ Vô Cữu (do_vo_cuu) called.

ties.note: the envoy's man
his dice partner
keeper of the third witness-house at Thạch Kiều
servant who sweeps the Bridge Court steps

people.role: The Pivot's resident envoy at Lạc Hà Tông
people.appearance: Back as straight as a drawn bow; she keeps her laugh for letters.
people.backstory: Lives at Lạc Hà Tông as the Pivot's envoy and writes the monthly letter on the Ferry War tolls; Lạc Hà's head Tô Vãn Chiếu (to_van_chieu) is courteous to her and tells her nothing. She tells the Lake's secretary which of the Pivot's letters are bluffs, for a seat nearer the table; it was her word that let Lạc Hà call Mâu Tri Viễn's (mau_tri_vien) toll bluff last year.

ties.note: her hall master
her courteous host

people.role: Envoy to the vassals, who rides Cửu Cao's cranes
people.appearance: Rubs a bruised hip when he thinks no one is watching; feathers always caught in his hair.
people.backstory: Carries the Pivot's letters to its seven vassals on a borrowed crane of Cửu Cao Phái (A091), and has been thrown twice by the crane king Ung Hạc Minh (ung_hac_minh) tamed in 1197 (A097).

ties.note: his hall master
lends him cranes and laughs at him
the Cửu Cao courier; they share a road and a flask
servant who feeds Cửu Cao Phái's message cranes at the seat

people.role: Drillmaster of the seat guard, Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: A whistle on a cord, frost-cracked lips, two fingers gone from the left hand.
people.backstory: Born under Thiết Châm Phong, the Anvil Peak, he fought at Đan Sơn Mạch in 1158 (C190) under Ngũ Trấn Bắc (ngu_tran_bac) and has drilled the seat guard every dawn since as if the next war starts tomorrow. He drills the guard until it vomits, and left Cung Trực (cung_truc), who fainted, lying in the snow until his ears blackened with frost.

ties.note: his commander
the Thunder girl
wants the war
Phất Y's contract-keeper; he signs the valley's standing fee each spring over go with her, and he would be the one to read the southern contract aloud in the war hall
inner disciple of the Dao Quang Hall, a spear trainee
captain of the seat gate, Dao Quang Hall

people.role: Keeper of the old beacon line, which she is quietly relighting
people.appearance: Soot to the elbows; turns a flint-striker over as other people fidget.
people.backstory: Has spent ten years putting fire baskets back on the beacon forts the Pivot stood down after the truce, Phong Toại Bảo first (V112), on Nhiếp Minh Tiễn's (nhiep_minh_tien) orders and no one else's.

ties.note: gave the order

people.role: Keeper of the seat's Seven-Star Array
people.appearance: Never seen sitting; candle wax scars her palms and her eyelids hang heavy.
people.backstory: Born on Xu Trụ Phong, where the Dipper Handle Canon is cut in seven columns, she relights the seven anchors of the seat's array each dusk and has not slept away from it in forty years; Thiện Thừa Củ (thien_thua_cu) calls her the array's eighth star.

ties.note: her hall master
learns the anchors
inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall, who cleans the Seven-Star Array's nodes

people.role: Array keeper on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Pale lashes, bright eyes, bad knees she walks off slowly.
people.backstory: Born on the pilgrims' thousand steps of Trích Tinh Phong (A095) with Light in her root, she keeps the warding array over Tinh Tủy Mạch beside Hình Thủ Tinh (hinh_thu_tinh), and its anchor stones remember three years when no one fed them.

ties.note: her hall master
the warden

people.role: Assayer of the open scales at Song Kiều
people.appearance: Voice worn to a rasp by the morning shouting; a ledger-pad strapped to his forearm.
people.backstory: Weighs the miners' ore in the open square of Song Kiều as the Pivot has since 235 (A219). Since 1198 his side has weighed almost nothing, and his tallies go four months up the road to Đặng Quân Bình (dang_quan_binh). Ôn Song Ngọc (on_song_ngoc) has asked him what the Pivot would pay to have the miners back.

ties.note: his hall master
the vassal assayers' head
the Thôi Tinh mine overseer whose ingots he weighs every month
the Chân Kim assayer; a friendship conducted by shouting
the Ôn carter, the first cart every morning
the Chân Kim assayer across the square, whose line has all the custom
inner disciple, assay apprentice at Song Kiều
the Ôn go-between who asked what the Pivot would pay to have the miners back
the old carrier who stands beside the house's pan whenever it is tested

people.role: Master of the mint at Bạch Ngân
people.appearance: Bites every coin he is handed, even the ones he struck himself; a die-stamp bruise on the heel of one thumb.
people.backstory: Strikes the Pivot's silver coin at Bạch Ngân below the cinnabar slopes (A224) and counts every blank twice; he has found three forged dies in forty years and traced none of them. He skims one coin in a thousand into his own sleeve and counts that twice too; his niece Mạch Tuệ Kim (mach_tue_kim) has been docked twice for the shortfall.

ties.note: his hall master
inner disciple, apprentice at the Bạch Ngân mint
his niece; coin striker at the Bạch Ngân mint

people.role: Keeper of the standard scales of Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: A beam-balance tattooed small inside one wrist; the tallest woman at the market, she stoops to the scale.
people.backstory: Keeps the standard weights of Thiên Quyền Thị, the fairest scales on the continent (A207), and checks every merchant's weights against the Pivot's at each new moon. Three seasons running Hoa Cái's cinnabar baskets from the diggings have come in light, and she wrote it up to Đặng Quân Bình (dang_quan_binh); the treasury now proposes to take the lease back.

ties.note: her hall master
the Hoa Cái foreman whose baskets have come in light three seasons running
inner disciple, apprentice to the standard scales at Thiên Quyền Thị
clerk of the open scales at Thiên Quyền Thị

people.role: Overseer of the black-iron mine at Huyền Thiết
people.appearance: Shoulders like a cart-yoke; black-iron rime in the creases of his neck.
people.backstory: Oversees Huyền Thiết, where a cart carries one ingot (A220); he once carried two for a bet, and in 1160 he found a mute boy sitting on a third and sent him up to Đỗ Tinh Hà.

ties.note: his hall master
the boy he sent up the mountain
the Thôi Tinh girl whose father was his foreman
deputy overseer of the black-iron mine at Huyền Thiết, who picks the miners' children for the outer gate
inner disciple sent back to the Huyền Thiết mine

people.role: Guard captain on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Heavy brows, a notched ear; he says nothing for a long time before he speaks.
people.backstory: Has captained the doubled guard on Tinh Tủy Mạch since 1189 (A096); an ancestor of his served on the vein and died on Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803, which no one in the family has thought strange. He kept Mộ Viễn Sơn (mo_vien_son) on the wall all one night with a frozen foot rather than relieve him, and the boy limps.

ties.note: the warden
covers his evening watch
inner disciple of the vein watch on Tinh Tủy Mạch
keeper of the watch book on Tinh Tủy Mạch

people.role: A young guard on Tinh Tủy Mạch who watches Băng Tâm's border
people.appearance: A thin boy with a sentry's squint; his hand half-lifts in a wave before he remembers.
people.backstory: Until 1189 he waved each evening to a Băng Tâm watcher on the walls of Khuy Tinh Bảo across the valley; Băng Tâm barred the doors after the petition (V070), and he still watches the shut gate.

ties.note: the warden
his captain, who covers for him
inner disciple of the vein watch on Tinh Tủy Mạch

people.role: Steward of the seat's stores, the incense and the old bridge stones
people.appearance: Smells of scented wood; a prim bun, a pinch of ash on one cheek.
people.backstory: Keeps the seat's stores, burns the scented wood of Mộc Hương Thôn in the Pivot's hall (A211) and dusts the old stones of Thạch Kiều's bridge that have been kept there since 1050 (A216). She sells the hall's spent incense ash in Thạch Kiều as a charm, and docks Ổ Tiểu Đàn's (o_tieu_dan) rice whenever the ash comes up short.

ties.note: the seat's steward
the servant boy who tends her fires
head of the seat's kitchen, a servant
keeper of the seat's water clock and its one dusk bell
keeper of the seat's rosters under the seat steward

people.role: Captain of the sea patrol at Tinh Hán Thành
people.appearance: A gold hoop in one ear; she walks with a harbour roll, as if the deck were still moving.
people.backstory: Born in Tinh Hán Thành on the reef of the sea-serpent's bones (C067), she runs the Pivot's three patrol boats on the inland sea and will have the harbour when Bộc Trầm Chu (boc_tram_chu) dies, which he keeps not doing. She takes a tithe from each smuggler's boat she lets pass, and put the blame for the missing tithe on Lư Kiểm Phàm (lu_kiem_pham), who was fined for it.

ties.note: the old harbour master
steward of the harbour scales at Tinh Hán Thành

people.role: Warden of the gate of Khai Dương Thành
people.appearance: A lantern scar in the shape of a crescent on his forearm; the stoop of a man who has leaned on one gate for forty years.
people.backstory: Keeps the gate of Khai Dương Thành that was rebuilt to face the morning star (A092), and opens it before dawn so the city can wake before the sun.

ties.note: his hall master

people.role: The seat's pill-maker, who brews with Hoa Cái Đường's cinnabar
people.appearance: Cinnabar-red at the wrists; her cheeks flush every time she lifts a lid.
people.backstory: Born at the cinnabar diggings of Thần Sa Khoáng (A208), she brews the seat's wound pills from cinnabar bought from La Tử Vi (la_tu_vi) of Hoa Cái Đường, and buys at a discount the sleeping pills the Hall sends home with its sick washers. She knows what the pouches are for and asks for the discount; the washers who take them home are the ones Mễ Hòa Thu (me_hoa_thu) buries.

ties.note: sells her the cinnabar and her secrets; buys her sleeping pills by the pouch
sends her miasma-root
outer disciple who gathers milkvetch for the seat's pill-maker

tree.intent: Metal linh lực for long brews.

people.gloss: One who knows the music: tri âm, a true friend
people.role: Junior envoy and Bách Vong Ngôn's letter-carrier
people.appearance: Thin calves; her fingers drum a tune on her satchel when she thinks no one hears.
people.backstory: Carries Bách Vong Ngôn's (bach_vong_ngon) letters to Vạn Hác Viện and back, is the only person at the seat who has heard him play, and has begun, in secret, to learn.

ties.note: the envoy with the zither
courier of the Khai Dương Hall between the seat and the witness-houses

people.role: Servant who tends the scented-wood fires of the Pivot's hall
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch, R2): a Wood-rooted boy who tends the hall's incense; outside the lineage
people.appearance: Sandalwood smoke in his clothes; eyelids that droop by noon.
people.backstory: Came up from Mộc Hương Thôn with the cartload of scented wood the hall burns (A211) and stayed to tend the fires; his Wood root has no place in the lineage. He naps behind the censers when the hall empties; last winter the fire died on his watch and Hà Khắc Thủy (ha_khac_thuy) was blamed and went without supper.

ties.note: the steward who feeds him

people.role: Warden of the deer meadow of Lộc Uyển
people.appearance: Antler-velvet stains on his sleeves; a gentle voice for deer, none for people.
people.backstory: Has kept the deer meadow of Lộc Uyển, where the Pivot forbade hunting in 380 (A086), for seventy years; he never built a foundation and never wanted to.

ties.note: the hawk hunts in the next valley

people.role: Outer disciple from the barley plateau
people.appearance: Barley-awn nicks across her wrists, sunburnt ears, a square chin.
people.backstory: A barley farmer's daughter from Thanh Khoa Thôn, a village built from the stones of Tây Quan Bảo (V108); she has an Earth root and almost no Metal, and she trains on the Level Beam twice as long as anyone.

ties.note: the outer gate's master
beside her on the beam
eats last with her

people.role: Outer disciple, a carter's son
people.appearance: Spread cart-boy's toes; a pocket that rattles with betting knucklebones.
people.backstory: A carter's son from Xa Ngưu Thôn who joined the outer gate for the meals and stays for the betting on who will tip the beam. He sends Thác Bạt Lư (thac_bat_lu) to haul his share of the weights while he bets.

ties.note: lends him stakes
owes him for wine
outer disciple from the yurt village
his sister; foot courier of the Khai Dương Hall, Phục Ngưu Nhi's sister

people.role: Outer disciple who cooks for the outer gate
people.appearance: Flour to the elbows; a round curd-pale face that goes pink over the stove.
people.backstory: Raised on butter and curd in Tô Du Thôn, she cooks for the outer gate and practises the weights in the kitchen with the cooking pots.

ties.note: eats last with her
trades her coats for curd
shares her bunk
the youngest outer disciple, who churns the butter tea

people.role: Outer disciple and falconer
people.appearance: A leather gauntlet he never takes off; a talon scar under the left eye.
people.backstory: A falconer's son from Liệp Ưng Thôn, Nhiếp Minh Tiễn's (nhiep_minh_tien) village, who brought his falcon into the outer gate and was told to keep it outside. He sets the falcon on the gate's pigeons for sport, and once on Hoàng Phiêu Bồng's (hoang_phieu_bong) goat kid, which did not live.

ties.note: from her village; she pretends not to know him
the outer girl whose lunch his falcon took

people.role: Outer disciple from the steppe
people.appearance: A broad steppe grin missing a canine; a wine-skin worn like a second belt.
people.backstory: From Mã Nãi Thôn, he sells mare's-milk wine to the outer gate, and half of it owes him money. He charges interest in wine and waters what he pours; Phục Ngưu Nhi (phuc_nguu_nhi) has drunk three months of debt into a fourth.

ties.note: owed for wine
drinks his wine
his cousin; outer disciple, Liên Phi Mã's cousin

people.role: Outer disciple, a nomad girl
people.appearance: Wind-chapped lips, an eagle-bone charm braided into her hair, eyes that look past the wall.
people.backstory: A nomad girl from Du Mục Thôn who joined because her clan's yurts move every spring and she wanted one place to stay.

ties.note: shares her bunk
the other herder
outer disciple whose Metal stands at thirty-six

people.role: Outer disciple at the sixth layer
people.appearance: Taps every wall he leans on and listens; his hands are mortar-grey.
people.backstory: A stone-house builder's son from Thạch Ốc Thôn at the primer's sixth layer, who failed the Level Beam once because his Metal will not carry the right pan; Hạ Hầu Thạch (ha_hau_thach) is teaching him to fail better.

ties.note: the old man of the weights
the honest one he is measured against
his cousin; outer disciple, a mason's daughter

people.role: Outer disciple from the dry edge of the steppe
people.appearance: Fire-red cheeks; singed ends to her plait.
people.backstory: From the desert-poplar village of Hồ Dương Thôn on the steppe's dry edge, with more Fire in her root than the lineage has any use for. She picks her sparring partners by the weather, and in a north wind it is always Thượng Hải Đông (thuong_hai_dong), whose wrist has been set twice.

ties.note: his falcon took her lunch

people.role: Outer disciple from the marshal's village
people.appearance: A rolling goatherd's gait; he sweeps with a broom he oils like a blade.
people.backstory: A goatherd from Thạch Dương Thôn, the war marshal Quý Trường Kích's (quy_truong_kich) village, who sweeps the barrow steps each autumn when the sect goes down to the plain.

ties.note: she gives him tea at the barrow
outer disciple who herds the outer gate's goats
gate guard of the outer gate on Thạch Quyền Phong
sentry of the barrow watch at Lang Yên Trại

people.role: Outer disciple from a camel-train village
people.appearance: Cracked heels; a string of copper cash around her neck clicks when she walks.
people.backstory: A camel-train girl from Đà Đội Thôn whose Metal grows a point a year; Chử Bình Quân (chu_binh_quan) has started setting her heavier weights. She lends her extra rice to Thác Bạt Lư (thac_bat_lu) at two grains for one, against the next pass of the beam.

ties.note: sets her weights

people.role: Outer disciple, a shepherd
people.appearance: Dog hair on his coat that never stops shedding; a staff callus on one palm.
people.backstory: A shepherd from Mục Khuyển Thôn who brought his dog and was allowed to keep it because it guards the weight rack at night. He leaves the dog on the rack while he sleeps, and Cung Trực (cung_truc) walks his night rounds for him.

ties.note: the other herder
guard of the seat gate

people.gloss: Knots the cord, the oldest writing
people.role: Outer disciple, a rope-maker's daughter
people.appearance: Rope-burn rings on her fingers; braided cords knotted into her cuffs.
people.backstory: A rope-maker's daughter from Thằng Ma Thôn who counts her breaths in knotted cords; Thích Minh Thư (thich_minh_thu) has asked to see the knots.

ties.note: wants to read her knots

people.role: Outer disciple, a ferryman's son
people.appearance: A knee that jiggles under every table; a laugh too loud for any room.
people.backstory: A ferryman's son of Mã Đầu Thôn who shot the gorge of Vạn Trùng Hạp in a day for a bet (A226) and came to the sect to learn how to stop.

ties.note: drinks his wine

people.role: Outer disciple who stitches the winter coats
people.appearance: Needle-pricked fingertips; felt-white fuzz on her sleeves.
people.backstory: A felt-maker's daughter from Chiên Mao Thôn in Dao Quang Lĩnh who stitches the outer gate's winter coats and is behind in the primer because of it.

ties.note: trades coats for curd
her sister; servant who knots the inner disciples' seven-knot cords

people.role: Outer disciple who tries to cheat the beam
people.appearance: Files his nails to a point; his eyes move faster than the rest of him.
people.backstory: From Hàn Mạch Thôn; twice he bought the Level Beam's weights in advance and failed, because knowing a weight does not lift it. In 1199 he filed one of the master's weights a hair light and lent it to Hạ Hầu Thạch (ha_hau_thach), and the beam held. He wants it for himself at this solstice, or the seat hears that Chử Bình Quân (chu_binh_quan) passed an altered weight.

ties.note: the honest one
gate guard of the outer gate on Thạch Quyền Phong
the gate master who let his filed weight stand; he has her by it
the old man he lent the filed weight

people.role: Outer disciple, a Thạch Kiều merchant's son
people.appearance: Moves his lips when he reads; wears a silk cord on a cheap wooden token.
people.backstory: A Thạch Kiều merchant's son whose father paid for his place in the outer gate in silver and was handed the silver back by Chử Bình Quân (chu_binh_quan). He pays Phục Ngưu Nhi (phuc_nguu_nhi) in promises to carry his weights, and being slow with sums has not yet noticed that none is kept.

ties.note: his gambling partner
runner of the Bridge Court

people.role: Outer disciple, a pearl diver's daughter
people.appearance: A salt-white streak in one eyebrow; ears that pop when she laughs; the long breath of a diver.
people.backstory: A pearl diver's daughter from Châu Bạng Thôn, Bộc Trầm Chu's (boc_tram_chu) village, with Water in her root and barely enough Metal for the outer gate.

ties.note: the old man from her village sends her pearls

people.role: Inner disciple of the Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: Nose broken across the bridge more than once; the neck of a man who has hauled ore.
people.backstory: A miner's son from Thiên Ngoại Khoáng who passed the Level Beam at nineteen; he wants the Dao Quang Hall and the war it is waiting for, and Nhiễm Thừa Nghiệp (nhiem_thua_nghiep) has told him it is coming.

ties.note: his drillmaster
from the same mine
inner disciple of the Dao Quang Hall, a spear trainee

people.role: Inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall
people.appearance: Gold flecks in her freckles; she cocks her head at anything that hums.
people.backstory: From the gold-essence diggings of Kim Tinh Khoáng, she learns the Seven-Star Array from Long Thủ Chuẩn (long_thu_chuan) and can already feel when one anchor dims.

ties.note: the array keeper
inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall, who cleans the Seven-Star Array's nodes

people.role: Inner disciple, the stele warden's son
people.appearance: Chalk-white sleeves; the bored, drooping mouth of a boy raised among stones.
people.backstory: Tả Khắc Thạch's (ta_khac_thach) son, who grew up among the steles of Giới Bi Phong and is bored by them. He tells the Thiên Cơ apprentices where his father hides his measuring book, for a drink.

ties.note: his father and master

people.role: The oldest disciple of the gate, admitted at 107 on a filed weight; teaches the weights
people.appearance: Wheat-straw beard at a hundred and seven; his shoulders still lift when a heavy weight is named.
people.backstory: A stone-field farmer from Thạch Điền Thôn who failed the Level Beam eleven times in eighty years. At the solstice of 1199 it held level for him on a weight Uất Trì Thu (uat_tri_thu) had filed, and Chử Bình Quân (chu_binh_quan) signed him in. His Metal of thirty cannot carry the Dipper Handle Canon, and he still teaches the new outer disciples to hold the weights.

ties.note: the outer gate's master, who signed him into the inner gate
the girl he taught to hold the weights and begged to stay
the young weight-carrier who calls him the old man of the weights
outer disciple at the primer's sixth layer, who failed the Level Beam once
his niece; outer disciple, Hạ Hầu Thạch's great-niece
the young cheat who lent him the weight

people.exception: Admitted to the inner gate in 1199 on a filed weight at the Level Beam (thien_xu §9); his Metal of 30 cannot run the inner canon
